title: The Political Theory of the Bhagavad-Gita
summary: This book is the first systematic analysis of the Bhagavad-Gita as a work of political theory. It fills a crucial gap by comprehensively exploring the classical text, and offers insights into the enduring impact of the Gita’s ideas on Indian political ideologies, movements, and rhetoric today. This innovative volume will be of interest to scholars of political theory & philosophy, political ideologies, religious studies, and South Asian studies.
